wholePhysicalScope: The named 35-point palace matches Wikidata Q3113788 and heritage register 25771. The map distinguishes the twisted rectangular block, four projecting corners, stairs, and eastern circular 1843 hospital addition.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the concave corner pavilions, west fronton, arcaded ranges and curved eastern addition. Near levels add glazing and molded plaster.
limitations: The current massing follows the restored late-seventeenth-century architecture and retained eastern addition. The released 2009 image controls surviving openings and wall ornament where they correspond with the final written record.

Exact final paint and roof tones, small sculpture, bay divisions, heights and cornices are approximate. The city park, church, detached gates, courtyard walls and later neighboring hospital wings are outside the model.
